title: octopus.json — an app of the octopus suite
description: Supersedes hub.json. `uses[].level` is the same vocabulary as `requires[].level` in octopus-template.json. validate.js is the executable form of this schema and adds the cross-field rules a schema cannot (feature required when level is 'feature', unique uses entries).

slug.description: Permanent identifier. Never renamed: it keys the app's accent, its access rows in octopus-auth and its place in the hub.

icon.description: One emoji, shown on the hub tile.

domain.description: Parent domain. Optional: the hub tooling supplies its own default.

access.description: private: hidden from everyone but admins until granted. open: visible to every account on release.

internal.description: Paths of service-to-service endpoints (behind the internal secret).

tools.description: Tool names cortex may offer for this app.

feature.description: Name of the feature that breaks without it. Required when level is 'feature'.

why.description: What it is for, in plain text.
